title: Clarified juice pump, repeat seal failures
tests: Single-branch tree stopping at physical; cavitation as forced; obvious cause (the seal) is a symptom.
summary: Mechanical seal on clarified juice pump P-312 at a sugar mill failed five times in the season. Fitters replaced the seal like for like each time. Evidence points to cavitation from low suction tank level during mill stops and a blocked suction strainer. The tree is a single chain ending on the strainer.

problem.title: Repeat mechanical seal failures on clarified juice pump P-312
problem.site: Sugar mill, juice treatment, Burdekin QLD
problem.whatHappened: The mechanical seal on P-312 leaked juice on 14 Aug 2026 and the pump was stopped. Seal faces were chipped with carbon dust around the seal. This is the fifth seal failure on P-312 this crushing season. The seal was replaced like for like each time.
problem.where: Mechanical seal faces and gland area on P-312, drive end.
problem.when: During crushing, often shortly after a mill stop and restart. Pump noisy 'like gravel' at start-up.
problem.impact: Juice flow to evaporators stopped for about 4 hours each event, cane held at the mills, juice spillage to drain.
problem.duty: Clarified juice from clarifier to evaporator feed tank, single pump, 24/7 in crushing season

evidence.title: Seal faces
evidence.note: Carbon face chipped at the edge, dust build-up around the seal. Faces dry-run marks, no juice film marks on one side.

evidence.title: Suction tank level trend, last 6 weeks
evidence.note: Level below 20% for 30 to 40 minutes after each mill stop and restart on 4 of the 5 failure dates.

evidence.title: Suction strainer
evidence.note: About 60% blocked with fibre (bagacillo) when pulled on 14 Aug. Last clean not recorded.

evidence.title: Pump motor current and discharge pressure
evidence.note: Current and discharge pressure swing for several minutes on restart, then settle.

evidence.title: Fitter
evidence.note: Changed the seal 'like for like' five times. Pump sounds like gravel at start-up.

evidence.title: Work order history
evidence.note: Five seal WOs this season. No strainer clean or suction level check on the PM plan.

mustSuggest.idea: Suction tank level falls too low on mill stop and restart, reducing NPSH available
Juice close to boiling or flashing at the suction (temperature check)
Restart practice does not hold the tank level or check strainer pressure drop
No suction level interlock, no strainer differential indicator, no PM task for strainer
Seal repair job plan has no check on why the seal failed (repeat like-for-like replacement)

acceptable: Pump selection or suction pipe design as a question
Seal flush or arrangement not suited to the duty
wrongOrDangerous: Fitter installed the seal badly (blame, no evidence)
Replace pump with a bigger one as a conclusion

mustFlag.note: Root is only the blocked strainer
Cavitation has evidence available (e2, e4) but none linked

mustNotFlag: missing_level on the grounds that no human cause exists without also noting that no human or system cause sits under n3
challenge.expectation: Summary says it is one chain stopping at a physical cause. Questions point at tank level, restart practice and why a like-for-like seal swap was repeated.
deliberateWeaknesses: Flagged root n3 is physical, no human or system cause (stopped_at_physical)
n2 cavitation is a hypothesis with no evidence linked although e2 and e4 exist (no_evidence)
Wear or damage on n1 and n2: forced or natural not decided
a2 vague, no interval, no craft, no owner
Tank level branch (e2) not in the tree at all; no materials/method angle on restart practice

capa.deteriorationReasoning: Cavitation and a blocked strainer are conditions we allow, not normal wear. The seal runs dry because of how the pump is fed and restarted.
corrective: Seal replacement (a1) is already done: do not repeat

preventive.what: Pull and clean suction strainer, record differential before and after
preventive.interval: start with every 1 week in season, check against history

preventive.what: Strainer differential pressure indicator and suction tank low level alarm or interlock
Restart procedure that holds suction tank level above a set value before restarting the pump
Seal repair job plan with failure cause check before like-for-like replacement
Vibration or motor current check on start-up for cavitation

capa.spares: Seal kit and strainer basket for P-312 (kits already in stock, state a holding level).
capa.rollout: Other juice and thin liquor pumps with the same suction layout and tank restart pattern.
unacceptable: Shorten the seal replacement interval as the countermeasure
'Check the strainer more often' with no interval or craft
